intro:
More than $10,000 off a brand-new ute, a new car for $19,990 drive-away, and Toyota offering $4,000 on the HiLux. These are the 10 biggest new-car deals in Australia right now (mid-November 2026), from smallest to biggest – with the prices, the end dates and the catch behind every deal.

Deals change fast and vary by state: always get the final drive-away price in writing from the dealer. This video is general information, not financial advice.
